name: Vacuum Cleaner Battery
definition: A vacuum-cleaner battery profile covers the cell pack, enclosure, connector, latch, charger interface, protection electronics and model-specific controls used by cordless cleaning appliances; it does not make packs interchangeable by voltage or appearance.
includedScope: Removable and integrated lithium-ion battery packs
Voltage, capacity, runtime, charger, BMS, connector and model-scope checks
Cordless stick, handheld and selected canister vacuum applications
headline: Voltage and capacity are only part of the match—connector, latch, charger, BMS and exact model scope control approval.
description: This profile separates pack architecture, runtime reporting and model-specific integration checks so buyers can compare documented cordless-vacuum battery families without assuming interchangeability.
metaDescription: Vacuum cleaner battery types, voltage and capacity, runtime boundaries, chargers, BMS, model compatibility and sourcing checks.
disclaimer: Physical resemblance, matching wattage, matching voltage, a generic family name or a seller claim does not establish compatibility. Verify the current manufacturer part number and revision, machine model and serial scope, electrical and control specification, mechanical and fluid or airflow interfaces, protection requirements and approved service documentation.
